items.prompt: A school bag costs Rp240.000. The shop adds a 15% fee for printing a name on it. How much is the fee, in rupiah?
A jacket costs Rp350.000. It is reduced by 20%. In the last week of the sale the new price is reduced by a further 10%. What is the final price, in rupiah?
hints: Find the price after the first reduction.
20% off means paying 80% of the price.
Then take 10% off that price, not off Rp350.000.

items.prompt: A phone costs Rp1.500.000. Its price goes up by 10%. What is the new price?
hints: Add the increase to the old price.

options.why: You added 10 instead of 10%. 10% of Rp1.500.000 is much more than 10.
You took 10% off. The price went up, so it should be bigger.
This is the increase only. The new price is the old price plus the increase.
